faq.q: How much does beachfront property in Halkidiki cost?
faq.a: Beachfront property is the most expensive type in Halkidiki, and prices vary with the area, the beach and the size of the home. A seafront villa in a sought-after part of Kassandra or Sithonia costs much more than a small seafront apartment elsewhere. Filter by price to see current options.

faq.q: Can you build right on the beach in Greece?
faq.a: No. As of November 2026, the beach and the shore zone are public, and building is restricted within a set distance of the shoreline. Existing seafront homes were built under the rules of their time, so your lawyer and engineer must check the permits of any house you consider.

faq.q: What does 'first line to the sea' mean in Greece?
faq.a: It means there is nothing between the property and the sea: no other building and usually no road. You walk from your garden to the beach. Homes on the second line sit just behind and often still have sea views.

faq.q: Which part of Halkidiki has the best beachfront homes?
faq.a: It depends on taste. Kassandra has long sandy beaches, organised resorts and a shorter drive from Thessaloniki. Sithonia offers quieter coves and clear water among pine trees. We can show you seafront homes on both peninsulas in one trip. We can arrange viewings in several areas.

body:
Seafront houses and villas

Seafront homes range from simple holiday houses to modern villas with pools. Expect higher prices than for homes a few streets back, and check how busy the beach in front gets in August.

Beachfront land in Halkidiki

Beachfront plots are rare. Building rules near the shore are strict, so an engineer must confirm what is allowed before you buy.

First line to the sea: what it means

In Greece, "first line" means there is no building or road between the property and the beach. "Second line" homes sit just behind, often with a sea view at a lower price.

Seafront property in Kassandra and Sithonia

Kassandra has long sandy beaches and more services nearby. Sithonia has quieter coves, rocks and pine trees down to the water. Nea Propontida, Polygyros and Aristotelis also have seafront homes in a more local setting.

Rules on building near the shore in Greece

As of November 2026, to be confirmed by our lawyer, the shore zone in Greece is public: nobody can own or fence the beach. The state sets the shoreline for each area, and building close to it is restricted. Check the official shoreline, erosion and the access road before buying.
